title_cyr: За кого ти цути Дано лицето
title_latin: Za kogo ti cuti Dano liceto
title_en: For whom is your face, Dana, blooming

lines.cyr: За кого ти цути Дано лицето,
lines.lat: Za kogo ti cuti Dano liceto,
lines.en: For whom is your face blooming, Dana,

lines.cyr: по кого ти шарат Дано очите,
lines.lat: po kogo ti šarat Dano očite,
lines.en: on whom are your eyes glancing, Dana,

lines.cyr: за кого ја чуваш Дано снагата,
lines.lat: za kogo ja čuvaš Dano snagata,
lines.en: for whom are you saving your body, Dana,
that slim body, Dana, like marble?

lines.cyr: Галено, галено Дано кој ќе ја
lines.lat: Galeno, galeno Dano koj ḱe ja
lines.en: Oh my caressed one, caressed, Dana,
who will fondle your blonde hair, Dana,
and kiss your lips of honey, Dana?

lines.cyr: Наскоро ми в' срце јадој ќе влезат
lines.lat: Naskoro mi v' srce jadoj ḱe vlezat
lines.en: Soon, worries will enter my heart
my white and red face will wither
that slim body will quickly fade away

lines.cyr: а и медно усте Дано овена.
lines.lat: a i medno uste Dano ovena.
lines.en: and these honey lips will wither, Dana.

lines.cyr: Бог да бие сите мајки, татковци
lines.lat: Bog da bie site majki, tatkovci
lines.en: May god punish all the mothers, fathers

lines.cyr: што лакомат за богатство и пари
lines.lat: što lakomat za bogatstvo i pari
lines.en: those who are greedy for wealth and money

lines.cyr: мили деца мажат, женат кај годе
lines.lat: mili deca mažat, ženat kaj gode
lines.en: who give in marriage their dear children, however they wish
and enslave their children until the grave.
